title: Investment Research & Decision Intelligence Platform
description: Five-module platform that turns financial statements, market data and filings into a Financial Health Score, DCF/comps valuation, quantified risk, and a source-attributed AI research analyst, ending in a full investment committee memo.
highlights: Deterministic financial-statement engine: profitability, efficiency, leverage and cash-flow-quality ratios across multiple years, plus a transparently weighted Financial Health Score, not an arbitrary one.

DCF built from a component-level WACC (cost of equity, beta, ERP, cost of debt), reconciled against comparable-company multiples, with bull/base/bear scenarios and Monte Carlo valuation distributions.
Risk engine covering historical, parametric and Monte Carlo VaR, Expected Shortfall, GARCH volatility forecasting, and configurable stress tests (rate shocks, margin compression, market drawdowns).

AI analyst is retrieval and tool-calling only: it pulls numbers from the financial, valuation and risk engines via controlled tools rather than generating them, and every claim is tagged as sourced data, model output, or interpretation.
Six-page investment-committee dashboard ending in a BUY/HOLD/SELL memo that states the explicit financial thresholds which would flip the recommendation.

title: Stock Screener CLI
description: A command-line tool that pulls daily price data and screens tickers against custom valuation rules.
highlights: Fetches and caches daily OHLCV data so repeat screens run without hitting the API again.
Rules are defined in a small config format, so adding a new screen needs no code changes.
Outputs a ranked table with the metrics that triggered each match.

title: Portfolio Rebalancer
description: Computes the minimum set of trades needed to bring a portfolio back to its target allocation weights.
highlights: Takes current holdings and target weights, returns the buy and sell orders to close the gap.
Accounts for a minimum trade threshold so tiny drifts do not generate noise trades.
Reports drift per position before and after the proposed rebalance.

title: Task Tracker API
description: REST API for managing tasks, built to practice authentication and relational database design.
highlights: Token-based auth with hashed credentials and scoped access per user.
Normalized schema with indexed foreign keys and migrations checked into the repo.
Integration tests cover the full request path against a real test database.
